audit.whatIsWrong: Five of the seven level rows disagree with both the packet chart and the matchup's own prose. Levels 2 and 3 are marked Vladimir while whys[1] and whys[2] say Kennen owns the mark-stun window; Levels 4-5 and Level 6 are 'Skill' while the prose says the stretch is his and 6 is Kennen's single best kill window; First item is Vladimir while the prose calls it a real kill.
audit.why: Sanguine Pool is 28s at rank 1 and is not available at levels 2-3, so Kennen's three-mark stun has no answer. At 4-5 Transfusion (9s falling to 4.6s) heals the chip back. At 6 Slicing Maelstrom out-ranges the pool's 350-range window once it is baited.
audit.corrected: Level 2 = Kennen, Level 3 = Kennen, Levels 4-5 = Vladimir, Level 6 = Kennen, First item = Kennen; rows 0 and 6 already correct.

audit.why: Spikes are right: Kennen at 2-3 pre-pool, level 6 Slicing Maelstrom (120s), first-item Alternator/Rocketbelt, Vladimir from two AP items. Vladimir's spikes are Sanguine Pool coming online, Hemoplague at 6 (120s), and Rylai's/Riftmaker.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sanguine Pool is described only as 'dodges your combo' with no duration or cooldown, Crimson Pact's HP-to-AP conversion is never stated where the HP-stacking mistake is called out, and Tides of Blood's minion block is absent.
audit.why: Riot's text: W 'becoming untargetable for 2 seconds', 28/25/22/19/16s. Passive: every 30 bonus HP gives 1 AP and every 1 AP gives 1.6 bonus HP. E 'can be blocked by enemy units', 600 range.
audit.corrected: Give the 2s untargetable / 28s rank-1 numbers as the bait window, name Crimson Pact where HP stacking is discussed, and use minions as an E shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal is listed in itemization but never tied to a trading decision.
audit.why: The missing-interaction file flags needs-antiheal: Transfusion and Hemoplague both heal him, so Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal named as a precondition for committing, in breakdown.mid and the level 4-5 rows.

notes: The packet defect 'Use Sanguine Pool' is a FALSE POSITIVE — Sanguine Pool is Vladimir's real W name. Level chart rows 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 flipped as one atomic group across both layers to match the packet chart and the matchup's own prose. Whether Sanguine Pool's untargetability drops an already-applied Mark of the Storm or only the incoming instance is not in the kit data and was not asserted.
